## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:列表页「管理视图」里,被改过的随应用安装视图带「已定制」小标记,菜单多一项「恢复出厂版本」,确认一次后所有人重新看到应用自带的视图。
- 为什么做:卡 #36011。此前置顶、改名或设默认后,想回到原样只能去 Studio 找定制项。
- 出错会怎样:只删该视图在 `.custom` 定制包里的覆盖(先草稿后正式行),出厂包不动、定制包本身保留;服务器拒绝时提示原因,定制原样保留。可整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。卡上两条验收都有用例钉住;L2(席位,`TIER_DEFAULT`,Clause-② 扩展)PASS 在案后由区落地。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36342` CLEAN(13 项无标记);draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36011`,两条验收(置顶后恢复则覆盖消失、列表回到包自带视图;无定制的视图不提供恢复)都交付,`Fixes` 正确;22 个文件 +837 −5;`check-governed-merges` NOT governed,842 行 ≤ 3000。
- 范围:diff 只在认领文件面内(app-shell 视图 CRUD/标题切换器、data-objectstack 适配器、plugin-view 管理视图、i18n 11 个包与 de 引号配对计数);无 server、protocol、`packages/spec` 改动。服务器端门的读数用的是未入仓的临时测试(探针,不是代码生成),PR 正文载读数,合规。
- changeset 逐句核:`restoreFactoryView` 先删草稿再删行、走 `DELETE /meta/view/NAME?package=PAIR`、非覆盖时什么都不发、定制包保留、`listViews()` 带出 `overrides`,均与 `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` diff 相符;「拒绝时用服务器原话」对应 `handleRestoreFactoryView` 的 `formatMetadataError`。四个已发布/触及包(app-shell、plugin-view、data-objectstack、i18n)都在 changeset 头。
- 抽查:`customized` 只在 `refusingPackages` 含该包且 `overrides.package === _packageId` 时为真(`objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`);`readonly` 行不显示标记和恢复(`ManageViewsDialog.tsx`)。`ensureCustomization` 只在覆盖声明核过之后才调用,不会给未定制的包新建定制包。新增 8 个键在 ar/de/ja/ko/ru/zh 中均为译文,无与 en 相同的值。
- 门禁 check-runs @ `767c872b`:45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;Lint & Repo Gates、TypeScript Type Check 均 success。dev 本地读数在 `f35f7f31`/`446de0ec`,合并 main 之后未在本 head 重跑(正文如实写 NOT MEASURED),以本 head 的 CI 为准。
- 接受的偏差(nit,不改本 head):① 只有草稿、没有正式行的覆盖,恢复时会删掉草稿后再报「定制包里没有它,什么都没删」,这句话不对;`updateView` 正常写正式行,列表上走不到这条路。② 确认文案说「在此处修改的名称、固定和默认设置将被移除」;若覆盖是在 Studio 里改过列或筛选,它们也会一起被移除,文案没提。
- 范围外去向:无。
- 落地条款:非受管。席位的 `TIER_DEFAULT` L2 PASS 在案、无未闭 must-fix/should-fix ⇒ 由区在 10 分钟内 ready + auto-merge。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `767c872b6600b0cb55508b8207e46a21bb1d073f`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset; no `packages/spec` path, no governed path in the file list). Inputs read: card #36011 body and all five comments (triage 7058829659, seat 4 claim 7073580743, os-dev-report 7075365451, handover 7075571521, seat 7 claim 7075950199), PR #36342 body, its 22-file list, the net diff against the merge base 99fbaa6d, and the 58 check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

Every public-surface change the diff implies, against what the PR body and changeset name:

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `ObjectStackAdapter.restoreFactoryView(objectName, viewName): Promise of DeleteViewResult` — new public method on an exported class. Widening. Named right (body and changeset). It reuses the exported `DeleteViewResult` / `ViewHomeDeleteOutcome` types unchanged, and the existing transports only: `client.meta.getItem`, `client.packages.ensureCustomization` (the same call `viewCustomizationHome` makes for `updateView`), and `MetadataClient.reset` with `state: 'draft'` and `packageId`, which on main already sends `?state=draft` and `?package=` to the existing `DELETE /meta/view/NAME` door. No new wire door, no request shape the client did not already send.
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `listViews()` flattened `config` row now carries the record's `overrides` when present. The return is typed `Promise of any[]`, so no declaration changes; it is an additive runtime key, copied only when the record carries it (a row without one is unchanged, pinned by the new test). Widening. Named right (changeset: "`listViews()` now carries a record's `overrides` declaration onto the flattened row"). The bare-spec arm already returned `spec` whole, so it already carried the key.
- `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `ViewTabItem.customized?: boolean` — new optional member of an exported type (`index.tsx` exports `ViewTabItem`). Widening. Named right.
- `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `ManageViewsDialogProps.onRestoreFactory?`, a callback taking the view id — new optional prop of an exported props type. Widening. Named right. `RowProps` is module-private. Absent prop or absent flag behaves exactly as before (no entry, no mark); `readonly` still wins. `hasEntryAboveDelete` only gains an OR term, so no existing entry or separator disappears.
- `@object-ui/i18n` — 8 new keys in each of the 11 locale packs (`view.customizedBadge`, `view.customizedTitle`, `view.restoreFactory`, `console.objectView.restoreFactory`, `restoreFactoryTitle`, `restoreFactoryConfirm`, `restoreFactoryDone`, `objectViewActions.restoreFactoryFailed`); the exported `TranslationKeys = typeof en` widens with them. Widening. Named right in substance ("the mark, the menu entry, the confirm, its result and the failure title, in every locale pack"). The de quote-pairing pin moves 121 to 123 for the two new interpolated spans, consistent with the two new de values.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` — `useObjectViewViewCrud` gains `handleRestoreFactoryView` and `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher` gains the `customized` verdict; neither hook is exported from `src/index.ts` (only `ObjectView` and siblings are), so no published declaration moves. Behaviour-only change, correctly carried by a changeset entry without a surface line.
- Nothing narrowed: no export removed or renamed, no member made required, no accepted value refused; the title switcher still returns `definitionReadonly: true` on every refusing-package row and adds `customized` only when `overrides.package` equals that row's package. `@object-ui/types` (`DataSource`) is untouched; the host feature-detects the method, as the adapter-specific calls beside it do.
- Accept-set: no server, protocol or spec change, so no door accepts anything it did not accept on main. The client-side refusal (no `_packageId`, or `overrides.package` not equal to it, sends nothing) matches ADR-0146 D2, which admits the `overrides` declaration from the paired `.custom` alone, so the pair the ensure door answers is the only package that can hold the row being removed; the "pair held no row" throw closes the remaining case.

### ② Semver level

- `Metadata-protocol: none` is true: nothing a metadata author can write changes (`overrides` is ADR-0146's existing key, only read here).
- AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3: `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. The changeset sets `patch` on exactly the four packages the diff moves (`app-shell`, `plugin-view`, `data-objectstack`, `i18n`), no fifth, none missing. Right.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, with `Metadata-protocol: none` beside it; the arm is from the closed pair and not `no (widening)`. True: three exported type or class widenings plus the i18n key set, nothing narrowed. The seat 4 claim's provisional `no (expected)` was amended by the dev on measurement and restated by seat 7's claim; the final declaration is the right one. `Check Changeset` and the Lint gates (which carry the ADR-0087 registration check) are success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in report 7075365451. Nothing to answer.
- Dev flag, Clause-② amended from the claim's `no (expected)` to `yes (widening)`: verified true in ① and ②.
- Dev flag, model-free commit trailers against the harness reminder: consistent with AGENTS.md (the model-free `Co-authored-by: Claude` pair is the rule; the harness trailer is an exemption, not a requirement). No action.
- Dev flag, out-of-scope tooling observation (`os-verify-lock.sh` waiter losing its slot), `carrier: none`, not filed: an observation outside classes a, b and c, which os-dev routes to the PR's Acceptance notes and does not file; the PR carries it there. Answered.
- Dev flag, a stuck lock waiter process the classifier would not kill: environment of the dev's container, no PR content. No action.
- Hand-over gaps the PR body names (targeted UI run after the merge, app-shell type-check after the merge, the rest of the derived gate list): answered by the head's check-runs, 58 in all, every one success or skipped, among them `Test UI` and all 16 shards, `Type Check UI`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Live E2E UI`, `Build & E2E UI` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`.
- The restore also discards the pair's pending draft of the view (Acceptance notes say so, matching Studio's restore); the confirm text names the name, pin and default only. Within the card's acceptance; not a contract change.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): the diff is client-only. `restoreFactoryView` is one item read, one ensure call and two keyed deletes; `listViews` copies a key per row already read; the title switcher's per-item `savedViews.find` is pre-existing and runs over the list's view rows, not data records. No new id materialisation or in-app join. No finding.

Findings:

No must-fix, no should-fix.

N1 (nit) — The PR body's Readings say the targeted UI run and the data-objectstack type-check are NOT MEASURED on 767c872b, while report 7075365451 says 72 files / 799 tests passed and data-objectstack type-check exit 0 on that same head; the two records of one head disagree. CI's green `Test UI` shards and `Type Check UI` make it moot for the verdict, but the body is the stale one.

N2 (nit) — `restoreFactoryView` deletes the pair's draft before its row, like `deleteView`, but when the draft delete succeeds and the row delete is then refused, the thrown error says only "was NOT restored" and carries no partial `outcome`, whereas `deleteView` attaches `outcome` for exactly that half-done state. Narrow in practice (both deletes sit behind the same `manage_metadata` gate), no contract effect.
